name: doxbox-mcp

tools.name: doxbox_health
tools.description:
Check that the Doxbox API answers, and which server this MCP is pointed at (DOXBOX_BASE_URL) and whether a key is configured. No API key is needed for this call.

Returns: { base_url, status, api, key_configured }.

tools.name: doxbox_list_documents
tools.description:
List the account's financial documents (invoices, receipts, credit invoices), newest first, one page at a time.

Args:
  - limit: documents per page, 1–100 (default 25)
  - cursor: the next_cursor from the previous page, to continue
  - tag_ids: only documents carrying at least one of these tags (ids from doxbox_list_tags)
  - response_format: 'markdown' (table) or 'json'

Returns: { count, documents: [{ id, documentNumber, documentDate, totalAmount, currency, documentType, paymentStatus, supplierName, tags }], has_more, next_cursor }.
The API offers no server-side filter beyond tags; to find documents by supplier, date, status, type or amount use doxbox_search_documents.

tag_ids.description: tag ids; documents with at least one of them

response_format.description: 'markdown' to read, 'json' for the full structured data

tools.name: doxbox_search_documents
tools.description:
Find documents by supplier, date range, payment status, type, amount or tags. The Doxbox API only pages newest-first, so this tool walks the pages and filters them here; it reads up to max_pages × 100 documents per call.

Args (all optional, combined with AND):
  - supplier: text contained in the supplier name, case-insensitive (e.g. "Globex")
  - date_from / date_to: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the document's own date (documentDate)
  - payment_status: 'Paid' | 'Unpaid'
  - document_type: Invoice | Receipt | InvoiceReceipt | CreditInvoice | TransactionAccount | Other
  - min_amount / max_amount: on totalAmount, in the document's currency
  - tag_ids: documents carrying at least one of these tags (applied server-side)
  - limit: matches to return, 1–100 (default 25)
  - max_pages: pages of 100 to scan, 1–20 (default 10 = 1,000 newest documents)
  - cursor: continue a previous scan from its next_cursor
  - response_format: 'markdown' or 'json'

Returns: { count, documents, scanned, scan_complete, next_cursor, total_amount_of_matches }.
scan_complete=false means older documents were not reached: call again with cursor=next_cursor, or narrow the filters. Documents whose date Doxbox could not read (documentDate null) never match a date filter.

Examples:
  - "unpaid invoices from July 2026" → payment_status='Unpaid', document_type='Invoice', date_from='2026-07-01', date_to='2026-07-31'
  - "what did I pay Globex this year" → supplier='Globex', date_from='2026-01-01'

supplier.description: part of the supplier name, case-insensitive

response_format.description: 'markdown' to read, 'json' for the full structured data

tools.name: doxbox_get_document
tools.description:
One document with its full metadata: amounts (net, VAT, total), supplier with CRN, dates, payment status, PO number, description, tags and the ids of its image pages.

Args: id (document id, from a list or search); response_format.
Returns the document object as the API gives it. For the file itself use doxbox_get_document_file_url.

response_format.description: 'markdown' to read, 'json' for the full structured data

tools.name: doxbox_get_document_file_url
tools.description:
A short-lived signed URL (about 5 minutes) to download the document's original file: the PDF or image as it was received. Optional image_id picks one page of a multi-page document (ids from doxbox_get_document); the default is the first page.

Returns: { document_id, image_id, file_url, expires_in_seconds }. Download right away; ask again when the URL has expired.

image_id.description: one page's image id; default first page

tools.name: doxbox_list_suppliers
tools.description:
The account's suppliers: every supplier that has documents in the account, with document count and total amount (in the account's currency), biggest total first.

Args:
  - name: optional text to match against the supplier's name or alias, case-insensitive
  - response_format: 'markdown' or 'json'

Returns: { count, suppliers: [{ id, name, alias, crn, documentCount, totalAmount }] }.
'name' is the supplier's registered name (stable across accounts); 'alias' is the name this account gave it, or null. Use the supplier name with doxbox_search_documents to see the documents.

name.description: part of the supplier name or alias

response_format.description: 'markdown' to read, 'json' for the full structured data

tools.name: doxbox_list_tags
tools.description:
The account's tags: the labels the business puts on documents (e.g. a project, a client, "tax refund"), each with how many documents carry it.

Returns: { count, tags: [{ id, name, color, documentCount }] }. Tag ids are what doxbox_list_documents, doxbox_search_documents and the tag-writing tools take.

response_format.description: 'markdown' to read, 'json' for the full structured data

tools.name: doxbox_set_document_tags
tools.description:
Replace the whole tag list of one document. An empty list removes every tag. A document carries at most 10 tags. Needs a key created as "Read & write"; a read-only key gets 403 API_KEY_FORBIDDEN.

Args: document_id; tag_ids (ids from doxbox_list_tags, all must belong to this account).
Returns the document's tags afterwards.

tools.name: doxbox_add_document_tag
tools.description:
Put one existing tag on a document; the other tags stay. Adding a tag the document already has changes nothing. Needs a key created as "Read & write"; a read-only key gets 403 API_KEY_FORBIDDEN.

Args: document_id; tag_id (from doxbox_list_tags).
Returns the document's tags afterwards.

tools.name: doxbox_remove_document_tag
tools.description:
Take one tag off a document; the tag itself and the other tags stay. Needs a key created as "Read & write"; a read-only key gets 403 API_KEY_FORBIDDEN.

Args: document_id; tag_id.
Returns the document's tags afterwards.

tools.name: doxbox_create_export
tools.description:
Generate an export file of one month's documents and return a download link (signed URL, valid about 12 hours). Exporting never changes the documents.

Args:
  - export_type: 'excel_monthly' (spreadsheet of the month), 'csv', 'pdf_merged' (all files in one PDF), 'zip' (the original files)
  - year, month: the month by document date
  - document_ids: optional; export only these documents (they must be in that month)
  - document_types / payment_statuses / search: optional filters, as in the app's export window

Returns: { file_name, file_url, total_documents, skipped_files }.

search.description: free text, as in the app's search box

tools.name: doxbox_upload_documents
tools.description:
Upload files from this machine into the account. Each file goes through the same pipeline as the app: OCR (Google Document AI), supplier matching and de-duplication, and appears in the account as "uploaded via the API". Needs a key created as "Read & write".

Args: paths — absolute paths of PDF or image files on this machine, up to 100 per call.

Returns, per file: status 'created' (with the new document id), 'duplicate' (the account already has this file; the existing id is returned, nothing new is made) or 'failed' (with a reason), plus a summary.
Uploads count against the plan's monthly document limit: when it is reached the whole batch is refused with 403 PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, and files beyond the room left are marked failed. Re-uploading is safe: duplicates never create a second document.

paths.description: absolute file paths on this machine

instructions: Tools for one Doxbox account (the one the API key belongs to): its invoices, receipts and other financial documents, suppliers, tags and exports. Start with doxbox_search_documents or doxbox_list_suppliers for questions about spending; doxbox_list_tags gives the ids the tag filters take. Amounts are in each document's currency; supplier totals are in the account's currency. Writing (upload, tags) needs a read & write key.
